snippet.title: The Warp | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#doom #doom2 #doom2mod
The Warp is a Doom 2 MBF21 Megawad with 35 maps using mostly original assets. It focuses on action, but rewards exploration and secret-hunting. It takes place across varied landscapes, including both familiar and more unusual level designs. The difficulty is moderate to high, but enemy numbers are reasonable and map sizes manageable, at least until the end. 

Download on Doomworld: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/153124-the-warp-out-now/

The wad has an original soundtrack, mostly written by the wad author. There are three guest maps, including a super secret true final map.

Features:
35 action-packed levels, including four secret maps
Two major secret areas/fights
Various easter eggs and secrets
Weapons, monsters and textures from Doom 2 + some new textures
Custom HUD and status bar
Original soundtrack in .ogg format
Two endings, one of which is the true secret finale
Detailed maps with lots to explore
Difficulty levels for different categories of players, ranging from a casual walk to a serious challenge

Credits:
Idea, maps, graphics and original music by Laocoön (MKLBST)
Secret maps by Hebonky and Painvile98
True final map, custom HUD and additional graphics by DRON12261
True final map music by Karl Casey (White Bat Audio)

Soundtrack on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w0Vq-8H-2NY&t=149s&ab_channel=Laoco%C3%B6n
